notes.title: v1.0.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*] Fixed an issue where music would not play properly when opening a box while the radio on the first floor was on.
[*] Fixed some image errors related to lockers.
[*] Some QoL updates related to the 'Karma' ending.
[*] Fixed some script errors in the Japanese build.[/list]

notes.title: Music DLCs have arrived!
notes.content:
[h2]Flower in Us Original Soundtrack[/h2]
Original soundtrack of the game 'Flower in Us'. Produced by k’əmgo. 16 tracks total, full length of 37:48. Provided in 320kbps MP3 and FLAC file format.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2567130/Flower_in_Us_Original_Soundtrack/
[h2]Flower in Us Piano Collections[/h2]
Digital sheet music featuring select soundtracks from the game Flower in Us. Provided as a 42-page PDF file. The cover of the PDF file provided with this DLC is temporary. Will be updated in the near future!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2567150/Flower_in_Us_Piano_Collections/
[h2]Coming Soon: Digital Wallpapers[/h2]
Images containing 6 key scenes selected from the game. Available in FHD(1080p), QHD(1440p), and 4K(2160p) resolutions. [b]Coming this week![/b]

[h2]Bundles![/h2]
Get an additional discount with our bundle deals!

notes.title: v1.0.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*] Fixed some incorrect entries in the ending credits.
[*] You can now skip the ending credits. (Press 'Z')
[*] Fixed a bug where the eye image of 'Peony' would occasionally remain on screen after the interaction ended.
[*] Fixed an issue where the menu could be opened during the [spoiler]"Television" ending[/spoiler] cutscene.
[*] Improved clarity in the early part of the game where the path forward was unclear.
[*] Adjusted the sound design in the [spoiler]first "Hallucination"[/spoiler] cutscene.
[*] Refined the music cue that plays when [spoiler]opening the "Bag"[/spoiler].
[*] Fixed an issue where audio could occasionally distort during music transitions.
[*] Added an extended version of a track that was previously included only in the official soundtrack, not in the game itself.
[*] Improved certain sound effects that were overly fatiguing to listen to.
[*] Fixed an issue where turning on the "Radio" with a preset frequency would cause a sudden loud noise.[/list]

notes.title: Day One Hotfix
notes.content:
[list][*] Fixed an issue where you could not obtain key items in certain situations, making normal game progress impossible. For those who experienced this issue, [spoiler]please make sure to select 'New Game' (covered by flowers) instead of 'Continue' or 'Select Chapter' when returning to the main screen after obtaining the 'Chat' button.[/spoiler]
[*] In order to completely resolve the issue above, we have disabled the Steam Cloud function.[/list]

notes.title: Demo Game Update Notice, etc.
notes.content:
Hello players, this is Chalkseagull at Team Gypsophila.

We are pleased to announce that the demo game has been updated with in-game bug fixes and Russian language support.

For the best experience, please make sure that the demo is up to date before launching it.


[h2]Bug Fix[/h2]

Fixed a graphical bug in the TV puzzle minigame.


[h2]Russian Language Support[/h2]

We sincerely thank you for your great interest, even though the game is still in the demo stage. In particular, players who speak Russian have voluntarily sent us translations.

Thanks to the excellent work of [b]Lei Onoe[/b] and [b]Anya Kanzer[/b], we were able to implement Russian language support into the demo. Try our demo in Russian by updating it to the latest version!


[h2]Status Report[/h2]

The final version of the game is currently undergoing the playtest, and its official release is just around the corner. Please allow us some more time.

We deeply appreciate your love and support, and we will do our best to live up to your expectations.

Thank you.
